main.description: An admin granting a member access, written to the registry space by approveMember. Append-only: re-granting writes a new record and a member is active iff there is a grant with no later revocation. The rkey is {memberDid}:{tid}, so the subject and the ordering resolve from a listing without fetching each record.

status.description: Always 'active'. A grant is never edited to revoke; revocation is a separate record.

litellmUserId.description: The member's DID. LiteLLM keys its user on the same value, which is what makes provisioning idempotent on retry.

groups.description: Tier identifiers as recorded at approval time. The vocabulary is NOT yet settled: approveMember currently writes the LiteLLM team alias here, which is a mutable display string. Anything consuming this downstream (Corliss's group claim, Open WebUI group names) needs a stable key instead, so expect this to change before the first consumer exists.

litellmTeamId.description: The LiteLLM team backing this grant at the time it was written. LiteLLM stays authoritative for current team membership; this records what was chosen, not what is true now.
